from problems import SubsetSum, Sat

* ``target < 0`` – always unsatisfiable; we return a SAT instance containing a

* ``target == 0`` – always satisfiable; we return an empty SAT instance.
* Numbers larger than the target are ignored; if all numbers are larger the
  instance is unsatisfiable.

    """Map DP state (i, k) to a SAT variable number (1‑based)."""
    return i * (T + 1) + k + 1
